test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fce92e2d2c4f2516b005751de55da7d6f1abf504406d0ea894560b43412da2ce.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The top row and bottom left corner elements shift anticlockwise.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ecfdb55f4c6e5a791df0374caa14c85594f1596bee31a4e69bb43084835091d.png] 

2) Second box series →

The right diagonal elements shift clockwise.

The left diagonal elements interchange positions.

The center element of 3rd column is replaced by new element subsequently. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b1c1c37bee40e09196a7a704cae7b25bf43cbd58f7f0cd2c7ed51d6d8b3d08b.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0e9d82d052b629e4aa370002e69ab3e2e16b5a2e897b1423134b7eeec35057a.png] 

Hence, "Option 1 is the correct answer.
